pages.text: Put woven cloth into a water cauldron with heat under it. A minute later it's $(item)Fulled Cloth$(), thick and tight.
pages.title: Fulling

pages.text: Lay fulled cloth on the $(item)Shaping Rack$() and use string on it. Stitch on the beat: right-click for R (needle in), left-click for L (needle out). Six stitches make two $(item)Cloth Panels$().
pages.title: Sewing
